A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]''' lived at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], honoring customs and traditions of the purged [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He wore a [[Robe/Legends|robe]] traditional for the [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi apparel]] and was on at least one occasion practicing with the training [[Remote/Legends|remote]].

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Jedi Padawan" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Monte Moore]].
